name: The Caldwell County Courthouse
description: The 1894 Second Empire courthouse in Lockhart, Texas, as a 65 cm LEGO display model on a 45 cm lawn: rough-faced buff stone with red trim, a clock tower on a broad belfry flanked by tall bell domes with round windows on the front and back, crested slate mansards on the four corner pavilions, a balconied entrance and columned side porches. The tower's four clocks really keep time (quartz clock inserts behind the red dials), and its dome lifts off to set them.
